name: auto-context-handover
description: Subagent-only context handover for Claude Code: measures child loops, nudges with staged escalation at the soft boundary, stores the model-written handover, and stops handed-over children. Roots get a context-only introduction; native compaction is unchanged.

soft.title: Soft threshold
soft.description: Child context threshold in tokens that triggers staged nudges. Positive integer only, uncapped (the child window is unknown). Default 200000.
